lines.text: A man going on a journey gives his servants five, two, and one talent, each according to his ability.
The five-talent servant gains five more, the two-talent servant gains two more, and the one-talent servant hides his master's money.
After three days the master returns and calls the five-talent and two-talent servants good and faithful.
The master calls the afraid servant wicked and lazy and says he should have deposited the money with bankers.
The master gives the talent to the one with ten and throws the worthless servant into a fiery furnace.
